goal: Test whether historical 5/6 events contain a reproducible strictly causal cutoff-boundary effect that remains after matched-cost null testing, without re-running prior omitted-winner rescue families.

scope.boundaryCase: missing winner rank near the frozen ticket cutoff
scope.deepCase: missing winner rank materially outside the frozen cutoff
scope.newQuestionOnly: Is boundary distance itself prospectively informative after conditioning on the frozen baseline?

forbiddenRepeats: reuse target outcomes to choose boundary width
antiDuplicateGuard.requiredNovelty: Boundary-rank distance must be frozen pre-holdout and tested as a separate causal covariate against matched-cost nulls and prior frozen baselines.

frozenRankerArtifact.selectionBasis: first-ranked v138 discovery leader only; no v138 holdout outcome is used to select this ranker

matchedCostNullSpec.comparison: For each eligible event, permute the 49 rank labels deterministically and measure whether the omitted winner lies at the same or smaller positive rank distance from cutoff=8; ticket/candidate budget remains exactly eight numbers / 28 six-number combinations / 14 EUR theoretical.

successMetric.name: boundary_rescue_rate_among_eligible_5of6
successMetric.boundaryDefinition: omitted winning number rank=9, exactly one position below frozen cutoff=8
requirements: at least 20 eligible discovery-frozen 5/6 events in holdout

sourceEvidence: v138 source commit 8d61282d4457404a47bbe25358bb0f6c59edad1c defines 32 causal graph-topology configurations, discovery 1989-08-13..2018-05-24, cutoff pool size 8 and 14 EUR theoretical budget
v141 commit 6ab3c6b324c9320ae2cb38e72bc4f1891ab727be establishes the same chronological split and prior negative sixth-number rescue family

successGate: Must improve reproducibly on frozen baselines in holdout and survive matched-cost null plus multiplicity correction; discovery-only 5/6 events do not count.
failureGate: Archive as negative or duplicate if boundary effect vanishes out of sample, fails corrected null testing, has fewer than minimumEligibleEvents, requires post-hoc threshold changes, or merely reconstructs v141/v142/v144/v145/v146.
